description: Record a callback request for the Kareverse team. The result contains a WhatsApp link the person must open and send to confirm; Kareverse only contacts people who confirm. First show the person Kareverse's privacy notice (https://www.kareverse.com/privacy) and say in one line where their details go (the Kareverse team's email, lead tracker and CRM, marked unconfirmed). Use only after they explicitly agree to be contacted and give their OWN name and phone number; set consent to true to confirm that. Never use it for someone else's number or for emergencies. May be temporarily unavailable.

consent.description: True only if the person saw the privacy notice and agreed that Kareverse may contact them about this enquiry.

message.description: Short background, in the person's words.

name.description: Name of the person Kareverse should contact.

parent_area.description: Where the parent lives in Bangalore.

phone.description: Their phone or WhatsApp number, with country code (e.g. +91 98765 43210 or +1 415 555 0100).

service_interest.description: What they need, e.g. 'Care Plan', 'Hospital accompaniment', 'Night caretaker'.

name: submit_enquiry
title: Request a callback from Kareverse
